Intel builds the Intel Turbo Boost Technology in their CPU in order to boost the CPU performance. The Intel Turbo Boost Max Technology 3.0 is the third-generation of this technology. ITBM 3.0 works much faster than the previous generations, so you can expect higher performance in your computer with this generation. To learn more, you can visit Intel® Turbo Boost Max Technology 3.0 .
